title: LevelUP! Tomes Drop on Death Addon
description: By default in the LevelUP! pack skill tomes do not drop on death. This addon simply adds that feature.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d388931f2ea7f9d1c59fdc3b4e66241a434a1ee5.png)
## LevelUP! Tomes Drop on Death Addon
There isn't really much to say here this pack just does what it says on the tin. It is an addon that makes it so when you die with KeepInventory off your skill tomes drop.
